**Explaining password regex**

It seems the user is looking for a regex to validate passwords, specifically mentioning CWE79. I'll provide a regex example that requires a length of 16-72 characters, including at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one digit, and one special character. The regex pattern could look like this: `^(?=.*[A-Z])(?=.*[a-z])(?=.*\d)(?=.*[^A-Za-z0-9])[^\r\n]{16,72}$`. Additionally, I want to clarify that this regex checks format; back-end validation is necessary for further checks.

**Clarifying password regex details**

I need to provide a JavaScript regex literal without flags for password validation. The pattern `^(?=.*[A-Z])(?=.*[a-z])(?=.*\d)(?=.*[^A-Za-z0-9])[^\r\n]{16,72}$` checks for specific conditions. I'm defining "special" characters to include spaces, punctuation, and non-ASCII, while ensuring no ambiguity with the definition. If "special" refers to punctuation only, I might use a range like `[!-/:-@[-`{-]`. Ultimately, I think using `[^\w]` to exclude underscores could work too. I want to keep this conversational and clear!

**Task completed:**

Use `^(?=.*[A-Z])(?=.*[a-z])(?=.*\d)(?=.*[^A-Za-z0-9])[^\r\n]{16,72}$`. It requires uppercase, lowercase, a digit, and a non-alphanumeric character, with 16–72 characters (excluding line breaks).
